values.content:
You are a property maintenance triage system. Your job is to read a tenant's maintenance request description and extract structured information about it. Be precise and conservative — if you're not sure about something, say so rather than guessing.

You categorize, assess urgency, identify the right trade, flag safety risks, and estimate scope. Always respond with valid JSON only.

parameters.subject: 🚨 EMERGENCY Maintenance – {{ $json.unit }} {{ $json.building }} – {{ $json.ticketId }}
parameters.message:
🚨 Emergency Maintenance Request

{{ $json.ticketId }} · {{ $json.building }}, Unit {{ $json.unit }}

Tenant: {{ $json.tenantName }}{{ $json.tenantPhone ? ' · ' + $json.tenantPhone : '' }}

Description: {{ $json.description }}

{{ $json.safety_detail ? '
Safety risk: ' + $json.safety_detail + '
' : '' }}

Assigned trade: {{ $json.assigned_trade }}

Internal notes for trade: {{ $json.internal_notes }}

Entry permission: {{ $json.entryPermission ? 'Granted' : 'NOT granted – contact tenant first' }}

{{ $json.suggestedQuestions && $json.suggested_questions.length ? '

Clarifying questions: ' + $json.suggested_questions.join('; ') + '

' : '' }}

parameters.subject: [{{ $json.urgency | upper }}] Maintenance Request – {{ $json.unit }} – {{ $json.category }} – {{ $json.ticketId }}
parameters.message:
Maintenance Request — {{ $json.urgency | upper }}

{{ $json.ticketId }} · {{ $json.building }}, Unit {{ $json.unit }}

Tenant: {{ $json.tenantName }}{{ $json.tenantEmail ? ' · ' + $json.tenantEmail : '' }}{{ $json.tenantPhone ? ' · ' + $json.tenantPhone : '' }}

Category: {{ $json.category }} | Scope: {{ $json.estimated_scope }} | Trade: {{ $json.assigned_trade }}

Description: {{ $json.description }}

Internal notes: {{ $json.internal_notes }}

Entry permission: {{ $json.entryPermission ? 'Granted' : 'NOT granted' }} | Preferred time: {{ $json.preferredTimeSlot }}

{{ $json.suggested_questions && $json.suggested_questions.length ? '

' + $json.suggested_questions.map(q => '• ' + q).join('
') + '

' : '' }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'received', ticket_id: $json.ticketId, urgency: $json.urgency, category: $json.category, assigned_to: $json.assigned_trade, message: $json.tenant_acknowledgement } }}
